reason: The finding describes the missed store update between the initial render's snapshot read and the effect's subscribe on the client path, which the fix explicitly addresses by unconditionally re-checking `Object.is(snapshot, getSnapshot())` after subscribing (PR bullet "Re-check the latest snapshot after subscribing to avoid missing an update between render and effect execution"), though it does not mention the headline resubscribe-on-`subscribe`-change defect.
